reviewer_role: Independent review_hardening agent; code/CI review plus raw SQLite and read-only Docker-resource checks.

cursor_review.reason: Core protocol8/filter=all scalar cursors are position tickets. Numeric zero carries no room positions, so unplaced rooms begin at their current head. Rewinding a genuine captured ticket restores stored room positions.

static_guards_reviewed: digest-pinned official images and unchanged upstream Compose hash
fresh random project and private generated credentials
loopback dynamic service ports and no host database port
named project-scoped nonexternal volumes only, no host mounts
ownership-validated teardown and source hash assertions
isolation_review.independent_postrun_docker_queries: No containers, volumes or networks remain for any of the three exact recorded disposable project labels. No native resources were selected or modified.

ci_review.artifact_upload_scope: Only runner.temp/findback-fresh-stack.json; no private state/config/compose logs uploaded.

credential_scan.method: Exact private credential-value byte scan against all fresh-stack reports and three evaluation/review reports. Values and paths are not included.

limits: The successful fresh reports exercise scripted fictional humans and a simulated handover, not a physical recovery.
The lost-ACK condition is deliberately injected; resulting server replay is real.
The first fixture attempt failed at its cursor-zero harness expectation and remains preserved.
Static isolation guards and current empty project-resource queries do not constitute an independent historical container forensic capture.
CI workflow execution status must be checked separately after publication; local success is not a claim of GitHub-hosted green checks.
